title: Is anyone else’s Mall in Mall World 90’s themed?
content: I’ve been to the 90’s mall twice now. It had tons of old restaurants in a food court area. There were tons of people eating at all the different themed restaurants. I recall being sick with a heart condition and was being wheeled around in a wheelchair by a friend I had in high school. I felt sick and paralyzed had had some sort of device over my heart on my chest. I remember specifically looking for my mother who was going to take me to the Doctor’s office. My friend was messing around and kept taking me to all these different areas of 90’s mall world. One section was a 90’s toy store and had a bunch of old legos and old Star Wars toys and had an old arcade. There were also old 90’s TV commercials playing on a bunch of screens. I finally got him to help me find my mother, we found her and then I woke up. I’m just curious if anyone else has been to this version of mall world.
